say:2:1230409001:1.text: If I had any say in this, I wouldn't want Carmine Whispers to make peace with the Water Wights.
say:2:1230409001:1.source_cn: 如果可以，我不希望血薇帮和水鬼帮和解。
say:2:1230409001:1.male: If I had any say in this, I wouldn't want Carmine Whispers to make peace with the Water Wights.
say:2:1230409001:1.female: If I had any say in this, I wouldn't want Carmine Whispers to make peace with the Water Wights.

say:3:1230409002:1.text: We must give those sinners a dose of their own medicine!
say:3:1230409002:1.source_cn: 血债从来只能用鲜血偿还！
say:3:1230409002:1.male: We must give those sinners a dose of their own medicine!
say:3:1230409002:1.female: We must give those sinners a dose of their own medicine!

say:4:1230409003:1.text: My mother... is too set in her own ways. I wish she could find peace instead of obsessing over revenge.
say:4:1230409003:1.source_cn: 我的母亲……她有些偏执。比起复仇，我更希望她能平稳地生...
say:4:1230409003:1.male: My mother... is too set in her own ways. I wish she could find peace instead of obsessing over revenge.
say:4:1230409003:1.female: My mother... is too set in her own ways. I wish she could find peace instead of obsessing over revenge.

say:5:1230409004:1.text: The gang conflicts are over, but the pain they left behind still lingers. *Sigh*...
say:5:1230409004:1.source_cn: 帮派争斗已经结束了，可他们遗留的痛苦还在。唉……
say:5:1230409004:1.male: The gang conflicts are over, but the pain they left behind still lingers. *Sigh*...
say:5:1230409004:1.female: The gang conflicts are over, but the pain they left behind still lingers. *Sigh*...
